message: 七転びでもやや起き

name: Nanaka
message: 「You know, it kinda feels like we got stabbed in our sleep」

name: Synn
message: 「About yesterday?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah. Though part of it's probably because things had been peaceful for a while」

name: Synn
message: 「Things had just been going too well up until now」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You might be right about that. Here, thanks for waiting」

name: Synn
message: 「O-oh, thanks」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, moping around isn't really like us, is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... thanks for the food. Slurp~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Bwah, stiiiings!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't you think we've finally woken up?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-yeah... this'll definitely wake you up...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right, right! You're the leader of the Student Council, Synn, so you've gotta hold it together the most」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm fine. It's not like I'm discouraged or anything」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see. Yeah, you're right! That's the spirit」

name: Synn
message: 「What about you, Nanaka? You were looking down the whole way home, weren't you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tch, so you saw me. Well, of course even I worry when things don't go well」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But hey. Your energy is my energy! Digging in!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Kwahh. I put in a little too much wasabi!」

name: Synn
message: 「This goes way beyond just a little--stiiings」

name: Synn
message: 「Good morn--」

name: Misa
message: 「I challenge you!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Waaah, what's the big idea all of a sudden?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Vice President is burning with vengeance! I cannot afford to lose either. Rumble rumble rumble」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though you two were so depressed earlier...」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't underestimate me. Something like that is cute compared to the usual humiliation I suffer from you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha. Every single one of you is back to normal.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nothing stops a sore loser, right?」
Which means the only one left is--

name: Ria
message: 「Morniiiing! Is everyone doing super well todayyy!?」
Whoa, that's an unbelievable greeting.

name: Ria
message: 「Since I'm your upperclassman, I've gotta cheer everyone up!」

name: Ria
message: 「Now then! Let's start another fun, fun day of Student Council activities~~♪ Let's do our best-ing♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Senpai, you're acting weird.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She really just comes right out and says it, huh.」

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister. Please don't force yourself.」

name: Ria
message: 「E-Everyone's ganging up on me... *slump*」
She must have done that out of consideration for us. What a kind upperclassman.

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone. About what happened yesterday...」

name: Synn
message: 「There's a chance even stronger demons than yesterday will start showing up left and right from now on. Though I'd rather that not happen if possible.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, rather than just wishing it won't happen, I think it's best to make sure we're ready in case it does!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Couldn't agree more!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's not like we've lost yet, after all. We barely made it out safe.」

name: Misa
message: 「To survive, you have no choice but to win. That's common sense in the world of combat!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone...」

name: Helena
message: 「What's this? You all look completely fine. I wasted my time worrying.」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis!」

name: Helena
message: 「I heard the story from Ria. Yet here you all are, wearing such great expressions.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I don't quite know why, but it feels like a burning passion!」

name: Helena
message: 「I understand that feeling very well~\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「However, you mustn't take this lightly. You have already stepped into uncharted territory」

name: Synn
message: 「Uncharted territory...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Throughout all the demon extermination the Kujou family has done until now--not just me, not even Ria. In fact, I don't think even our mother has ever encountered a demon with that much power」

name: Helena
message: 「Do you understand now just how serious this Re-Crea is?」

name: Helena
message: 「Still, don't forget. It's also a fact that things are different from back when only a single member of the Kujou family was fighting」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah! Now everyone is here. I have my comrades with me!」

name: Helena
message: 「Even if the enemy grows stronger, as long as we surpass them, there's no particular problem, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That makes complete sense, but how exactly should we go about getting stronger?」

name: Helena
message: 「Good question. That's why I brought this today」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A special training menu?」

name: Helena
message: 「That's right. If you just put this into practice, lo and behold! You might just get stronger」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't say 'might'」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you make this yourself, Helena-san?」

name: Helena
message: 「I'd love to say 'That's right~' for you, but unfortunately it was someone else who's an expert in that field」
The Kujou family's connections are unfathomable.

name: Helena
message: 「Now then, once again. I hereby assign the Ryuusei Crusaders the mission of intensive anti-demon combat training and regular patrols」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yes, ma'am!」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm counting on you all. Do your best」
